official.deadline_note: The autumn 2026 round ran 16 January to 2 February 2026 and late applications cannot be accepted; the university states the next scholarship round will open in early 2027, without publishing a date.
official.application_cycle: Annual scholarship round running alongside the national autumn admission
official.status_note: Official wording: 'The scholarship application for studies starting in autumn 2026 is now closed. The application period was 16 January-2 February 2026, and late applications cannot be accepted. The next scholarship round will open in early 2027 for students applying to Uppsala University.'
official.tuition_coverage_note: Official wording: 'This scholarship covers the full tuition fee for an international Master's programme at Uppsala University. Please note that it does not cover living expenses.'
benefits: Full tuition fee for an international Master's programme at Uppsala University
No application fee when applying for Uppsala University's scholarships
Possibility to apply for more than one Uppsala University scholarship in a single application form, though only one can be awarded
eligibility: You must be a citizen of a country outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland
You must demonstrate academic talent and show interest in being in an educational environment
You can only be awarded an Uppsala University Global Scholarship for a Master's programme chosen as first priority (the programme ranked highest of the four allowed at University Admissions)
You must have applied for the Master's programme before the University Admissions deadline
You must meet the entry requirements for the Master's programme applied for; the application fee and complete supporting documents must be received by University Admissions before the deadline
You must not be admitted to one of the programmes listed as ineligible for a scholarship
requirements: Apply for an Uppsala University international Master's programme as your first priority at universityadmissions.se before the deadline
Save the eight-digit personal application number issued by universityadmissions.se
Submit an online application form during the scholarship application period including personal details, the scholarship programme(s) applied for, and the universityadmissions.se application number
Write a motivational letter of no more than 350 words reflecting the eligibility criteria of the scholarship programme
No documents need to be submitted with the scholarship application itself
documents: Complete national application through universityadmissions.se with the application fee
Complete supporting documents required by University Admissions, received before the deadline
Motivational letter of maximum 350 words written into the online scholarship application form
selection_criteria: Academic talent and an interest in being in an educational environment
Academic performance, obtained from the supporting documents submitted with the programme application
The written motivational letter submitted in the online scholarship application
Meeting all general and programme-specific entry requirements as well as the scholarship eligibility criteria
coverage: Full tuition fee for an international Master's programme
Living expenses are explicitly not covered
application_method: Step 1: Apply for an Uppsala University international Bachelor's or Master's programme as your first priority at universityadmissions.se and save your eight-digit application number
Step 2: Read the criteria for each scholarship and check the programme is not on the ineligible list
Step 3: Submit the online application form during the scholarship application period, specifying all scholarships applied for in one form, with the 350-word motivational letter included in the form
Selection runs at the same time as the programme admission selection process; incomplete or late applications are not considered
official.application_route: Programme application at universityadmissions.se with Uppsala as first priority, then one combined online scholarship form containing the 350-word motivational letter during the scholarship window.
official.citizenship_residency: Citizen of a country outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland.
official.international_eligibility: Open to citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland who are liable to pay tuition fees.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Master's programmes; students admitted to the Joint Nordic Master's Programme in Environmental Law, Biology NABiS, Evolutionary Biology - MEME, Implementation, Transformative Learning and Sustainability, Religion in Peace and Conflict, Transformative Game Design, or Turkic Studies are not eligible.
official.duration: The scholarship covers the full tuition fee of the international Master's programme applied for
official.description: Uppsala University offers scholarships each year to fee-paying international students applying for an international Master's programme, funded for the Global Scholarship by the Swedish Council for Higher Education. The university states the scholarships are highly competitive and that only about 2% of applicants are granted one.
official.program_type: Merit-based tuition fee scholarship for international fee-paying students
official.english_requirement: The programme applied for must be an international (English-taught) Master's programme at Uppsala University meeting the programme's entry requirements; the scholarship pages publish no separate test score.

verification.notes: Live-fetched the Uppsala University Master's scholarships page (last modified 2026-09-10) and the separate scholarship application guide (last modified 2026-02-03). Both confirmed the full-tuition-fee scope, the exclusion of living expenses, the citizen-of-outside-EU/EEA-and-Switzerland rule, the roughly 2% success rate, the 350-word motivation letter, the no-application-fee rule, and the 16 January-2 February 2026 closing dates. The URL given in the catalogue for the scholarships hub (uu.se/en/admissions/scholarships) returns 404. No monetary award amount is published anywhere on either page, so funding_amount stays null.

applicant_utility.summary: Uppsala is explicit that this is a coin-flip for roughly one applicant in fifty, so build your plan around the two separate windows that gate everything: the national University Admissions deadline for the programme, and the much shorter January scholarship window that sits on top of it. The programme and the scholarship are genuinely two procedures, and the scholarship form only asks for the eight-digit universityadmissions.se number plus a 350-word motivational letter written into the form itself - there is no separate upload. The single most common self-elimination is ranking Uppsala below another programme at University Admissions, because the scholarship can only go to the first-priority programme. Also check the programme against the published ineligible list, which catches several well-known joint Nordic masters.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Academically strong non-EU/EEA applicants who already rank a specific Uppsala Master's first and can cover living costs independently.
application_readiness_checklist: Rank the Uppsala programme first of the four choices at universityadmissions.se and record the eight-digit application number
Confirm the programme is not on the ineligible list before investing in the application
Ensure the application fee and all supporting documents reach University Admissions before the national deadline, not just before the scholarship deadline
Watch the scholarship page from early January 2027 for the application form link
Draft the motivation letter to the 350-word limit and keep it tied to the stated eligibility criteria
common_rejection_risks: Uppsala not ranked first at University Admissions
Documents or the application fee arriving late at University Admissions, which voids scholarship eligibility even if the programme admission succeeds
Failing the programme-specific entry requirements, since scholarship and admission selection run in parallel
Applying to one of the seven excluded programmes
Submitting an incomplete scholarship application or missing the scholarship window, which the university says cannot be recovered
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living expenses in Sweden, travel, and anything beyond the tuition fee itself; the university warns scholarship holders must still secure Migration Agency-compliant living-cost funding.
document_audit: No documents are uploaded with the scholarship application; the motivation letter is typed into the online form and capped at 350 words
Academic evidence is taken from the documents already submitted to University Admissions, so weak programme-application documents weaken the scholarship file too
You must list all the scholarships you are applying for in the single form, and only one can ultimately be awarded
The scholarship form link appears only while the round is open - it is not a permanent URL
The universityadmissions.se application number is required; losing it means a support email before you can submit
alerts: Only about 2% of applicants receive a scholarship, so never treat this as a fallback funding plan
The university will not award a scholarship to anyone who cannot secure living-cost funding as required by the Swedish Migration Agency, even with free tuition
Do not apply if you do not meet the Uppsala entry requirements - the process is not a second chance at admission
The next round opens in early 2027 but no date is published, so the application window is short and unannounced
The number of scholarships available varies from year to year
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: universityadmissions.se application with Uppsala as first priority and documents in on time, then one online scholarship form with the 350-word letter during the January window, with selection running in parallel with admission.
